case.narrative: My transfer is missing from my checking account.

On XX/XX/2024 I transferred {$150000.00} to my XXXX bank account, I paid a fee of {$25.00} for a instant transfer. I checked my XXXX account, and the money was not there. As of XX/XX/2024, the money is still missing.
Unauthorized wire transfer from my savings account.

I received a payment from a client through Chime. I created an account so that I could access the money and transfer it to my bank account. This worked. However the next payment I could not transfer as Chime says they sent a physical card and this needs to be activated in order to transfer the money. I can not transfer or even refund the money. They refused to help me while on the phone and hung up on me. They are basically stealing peoples money.

I have a checking account with TD bank and another checking account with XXXX, I did transfer XXXX dollars ( twice ) on XXXX XXXX from my TD bank account to my XXXX checking account ( XXXX ) the first one was credited to my XXXX account, the second one was rejected, on XX/XX/XXXX but on XX/XX/XXXX ( without my authorization ) they took {$500.00} dollars from my TD bank via XXXX again but it doesn't reflect on my XXXX account, I did contact TD Bank, XXXX and XXXX but I didn't have answer
